items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Hitler had decided that he couldn’t demoralize the Londoners with these bombings, so he moved up to the provinces.

ctx.x: No. They came too fast. This was a buzz bomb they called them. It was like a small jet plane. Something like the drones that you see today. And then they — Hitler had decided that he couldn’t demoralize the Londoners with these bombings, so he moved up to the provinces. And ours was one town where they experimented with a new anti-personnel bomb, called the butterfly bomb. And they would drop it, and it was about the size of a hand grenade.
